template: Hi {first}, this is Yoni Kutler with Crisp Short Sales reaching out about the listing on {address}. I specialize in helping agents and homeowners with the short sale process and can handle the entire process for you like all the paperwork, phone calls, and coordination that will be required to obtain lender approval. There is no cost to the agent or homeowner for this service - so its completely free to you and your client and i have almost 20 years of experience doing nothing but short sales every single day - so im confident i can help you if youre interested. Do you have some time for a quick call to go over your listing and what we do?
video_followup: Hi, just following up again and i wanted you to see i am a real person and i REALLY can help you with your short sale. Let me know if you got a second to chat.
first_fee_reply: Like i said, no cost at all to you or your client. I charge a flat fee of $5000 to the buyer, paid only if/when the deal closes. The most important thing is to disclose this cost to them in the listing - and then they can account for it in their offer price. Buyers are willing to pay for the service if they know its no extra money out of pocket and will help ensure approval.
